response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.o AS above_overall FROM per p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.o) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Patients whose HGB values are all NULL have no average and are excluded (they cannot exceed the overall average).
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10.
